column1: # GUI startup-smoke manifest — one row per launchable app.
#   offscreen   set QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen (Qt apps only, no X needed)
#   xvfb        wrap with xvfb-run -a (any GUI; needs xorg-x11-server-Xvfb)
#   wayland     set QT_QPA_PLATFORM=wayland (rare; for wayland-only apps)
# timeout: seconds to keep the process alive before SIGTERM.
#   We assert that the process is STILL RUNNING when the timer fires —
#   i.e. it didn't crash in the first <timeout> seconds. A clean early exit
#   is also accepted (some apps print --version-style banners and quit).
# Mark in-progress / known-failing rows with `# WIP:` to disable.
# ─── Qt apps — cheapest, no X server needed ────────────────────────────────────
# ─── Non-Qt (FLTK / GTK / X11 native) — need a real X server via xvfb ──────────
